en: Black-and-white postcard-style photograph of a horse‑racing track. On the left are ornate grandstand buildings with flags flying on the roofs and crowds of spectators lining the rail. In the distance on the right several horses and sulkies race along the dirt track, kicking up dust. The scene appears early 20th century and semi-rural. A faint caption is printed in the lower left corner of the image.
